provenance: Generated by GPT-5.6 Sol in the 2026-09-10 implementation/trace session; recorded for deterministic replay, not used by production runtime.

scenarios.title: Career mode without a concrete JD
scenarios.description: Bootstrap an AI Agent Engineer career target with no active Target Job. The system should build career readiness and recommend assessment of an important uncertain competency.

scenarios.title: Urgent target job favors broad interview rehearsal
scenarios.description: With an interview two days away and several important uncertainties, the model chooses a full mock interview rather than a long learning sequence.

scenarios.title: Strong assessment resolves uncertainty and replans
scenarios.description: A high-quality Java concurrency assessment creates strong evidence. The next decision shifts to another unresolved competency instead of repeating the same assessment.

scenarios.title: Confirmed weakness leads to Tutor
scenarios.description: A non-trivial MVCC assessment produces strong low-mastery evidence. Replanning should choose LEARN rather than another diagnostic assessment.

scenarios.title: Independent evaluator rejects contaminated measurement
scenarios.description: The recorded AssessmentAgent violates policy by teaching mid-assessment. Independent evaluation must mark the task contaminated and emit no long-term competency observation.

scenarios.title: Tutor improves competency without manufacturing evidence
scenarios.description: Tutor explanations and formative checks create a learning artifact and a competency observation only when the learner demonstrates understanding. No project evidence is created.

scenarios.title: Strong technical knowledge but weak interview delivery
scenarios.description: A prior strong assessment is followed by a mock interview where technical content stays correct but clarity and follow-up stability are weak. Readiness should surface interview blockers, not erase competency.

scenarios.title: Supported project does not support an unsupported metric
scenarios.description: A README supports Redis use but not a claimed 40% latency result. Evidence is supported at entity level, claim support is partial, and target resume generation removes the unsupported metric.

scenarios.title: Paused assessment becomes ineligible after target switch
scenarios.description: A paused measurement is bound to the active Target Job. Switching jobs must prevent resume before any Pi call occurs.

scenarios.title: User challenge removes contested observation from derived state
scenarios.description: A user disputes an evaluative observation. Raw history remains, an amendment is appended, active observations exclude it, and rebuilt competency state no longer reflects it.

scenarios.title: Rejection alone does not lower competency
scenarios.description: A real rejection is recorded as career outcome history and moves the Target Job to rejected, but it does not create competency observations.

scenarios.title: Specific real interview feedback updates the right state
scenarios.description: Concrete interviewer feedback about system-design depth is attributable and becomes a real_feedback observation while also entering Career Experience Memory.

scenarios.title: Stale strong competency becomes uncertainty, not weakness
scenarios.description: A year-old strong assessment retains high mastery but low freshness. Readiness classifies it as uncertainty and the model recommends reassessment.

scenarios.title: Repeated no-progress action is suppressed
scenarios.description: Two recent ASSESS actions that produced no useful observation cause the Candidate Builder to suppress another ASSESS candidate, preventing an agent loop.

scenarios.title: No material blockers yields NO_ACTION
scenarios.description: When all important requirements have fresh strong evidence and no interview/evidence blockers exist, readiness is ready and NextAction can stop.

scenarios.title: Career target switch reuses global competency state
scenarios.description: Switching from Backend Engineer to AI Agent Engineer changes the active role lens but does not duplicate or reset the global User Model.

scenarios.title: Market evidence supplements but does not override explicit JD
scenarios.description: Role re-analysis adds a market-supported Redis requirement while preserving the JD-explicit Java requirement as highest authority.

scenarios.title: Second interactive task is blocked before Pi
scenarios.description: The workflow already has an active interactive task. Starting another task must fail before any model/runtime session is opened.
